maneder.no: Kjølig (13 °C), regn. Museer uten kø; Delfi og Meteora kalde.
maneder.en: Cool (13 °C), rain. Museums without queues; Delphi and Meteora cold.
Cool (14 °C), almond trees in bloom. Quiet.

maneder.no: Ideelt (21 °C), blomster. Gresk påske faller ofte i april.
maneder.en: Ideal (21 °C), flowers. Greek Easter often falls in April.

maneder.no: Varmt (27 °C), tørt. Beste måned for Akropolis og Peloponnes.
maneder.en: Warm (27 °C), dry. Best month for the Acropolis and the Peloponnese.
Hot (32 °C). The Athens Festival begins (see events). High season.

maneder.no: Svært varmt (34 °C), hetebølger; Akropolis kan stenge midt på dagen.
maneder.en: Very hot (34 °C), heatwaves; the Acropolis may close at midday.
Very hot (34 °C). Athens empties around 15 Aug.

maneder.no: Varmt (30 °C), tørt. Fortsatt sommer, færre folk.
maneder.en: Warm (30 °C), dry. Still summer, fewer people.

maneder.no: Behagelig (24 °C). Ideelt for rundreise. Lite folk.
maneder.en: Pleasant (24 °C). Ideal for touring. Few people.
Cool (14 °C), rainy. Christmas atmosphere in Athens.
